spans.s:
m. (-डः)
A kettle drum.

n. (-णं)
A measure or weight, a Tola.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A city, a town.
E.
द्रम to go, affix गन्.

m. (-मा)
Firmness, hardness, heaviness.
E.
दृढ hard, firm, इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Hardest, very hard or firm, &c.
E.
दृढ with the superlative affix, इष्ठन् and the liquid substituted for the vowel; also with ईयसुन् affix द्रढीयस् (-यान्-यसी-यः.)

mn. (-प्सः-प्सं)
Thin or diluted curds.
E.
दृप to please, affix स; also त्रप्स and द्रप्सा.

n. (-प्सां)
Thin or diluted curds.
E.
दृप to please, affix स्यः or it is derived from तृप to be satisfied, त being changed to द.

r. 1st cl. (द्रमति)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Dropping, oozing.
2

Flowing.
3

Fluid, liquid.
4 Fused, liquefied, melted.
m. (-वः)
1 Going, motion.
2 Flight, retreat.
3 Sport, amusement.
4 Juice, essence, exudation.
5 Fusion, liquefaction.
6

Decoction.
7

Dropping, distilling, trickling.
E.
द्रु to go, to go out of, to drop, affix अप्.

m. (-वः)
1 Flight, retreat.
2 Speed, going quickly.
3 Flowing, running.
4 Fusion, liquefaction.
5 Heat.
E.
द्रु to go, affix घञ्.

m. (-जः)
Treacle.
E.
द्रव, and ज born.

Going.
2

Dropping, exuding.
3 Heat.
E.
द्रु to go, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
1 Trickling, oozing.
2 Running, flowing.
3 Going.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A river in general.
2 A medicinal plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.)
E.
द्रु to go, affix शतृ.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Fluidity, natural or artificial.
2

Distillation.
3

Fusion.
E.
द्रव, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्रवता.

f. (-सा)
Lac.
E.
द्रव, and रस juice.

m. (-रः)
A small vessel, a receiver.
E.
द्रव juice, distillation, &c. and आधार what receives.

m. (-डः)
A man of an outcaste tribe, descended from a degraded Kṣatriya.
f. (-डी)
One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.

m. (-डः)
1 A country, properly the coast of Coromandel from Madras to Cape Comorin, or the country in which Tamul is spoken.
2 A native of Drāvira or

Drāviḍa.
3
A Brahman of Dravira, or rather of the south, five Drāviras being specified, or Drāvira, Karṇāṭa, Gujjerāta, Mahārāṣṭra, and []

Telanga.
4

A particular number.
5 Zedoary.
E.
द्रविड, and अण् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Wealth, property, thing, substance.
2

Gold.
3

Strength, power.
E.
द्रु to go, इनन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
द्रविण strength, and नाशन destroying.

m. (-दाः)
AGNI.
E.
द्रविण, and दास् who gives.

n. (-णं)
Liquefying, melting.
E.
द्रव fluid, करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Melted, liquefied.
E.
द्रव, कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fluid, liquefied, fused.
E.
द्रव, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Hard, solid, congealed.
E.
द्रव, and इतर reverse.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Fit, proper, right, what is or ought to be.
2 Derived from or relating to a tree.
n. (-व्यं)
1 Wealth, property.
2 Substance, thing, the receptacle or substratum of properties, &c.
3 Elementary substance, nine kinds of which are reckoned: viz. earth, water, fire, air, æther, time, space, soul, and intellect.
4

Brass.
5

A stake, a wager.
6 A drug, a medicament, any thing used in medicine.
7 Anointing, plastering.
8 Lac, the animal dye.
9 Extract, gum, resin, &c. derived from vegetables.
10 Modesty, propriety.
11 Spirituous liquor.
E.
द्रु a tree, affix यत्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be set in motion, to be put to flight, &c.
2 Fusible, liquefiable, to be made fluid.
E.
द्रु to go, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-कः)
A carrier or taker of any thing.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-नं)
Use or employment of any article.
E.
द्रव्य, and प्रयोजन purpose.

Material.
2

Having or holding any thing.
E.
द्रव्य, मयट् aff.

m. (-ज्ञः)
Offering oblations, sacrifice, &c.
E.
द्रव्य, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

mfn. (-वान्-ववी-वत्)
Rich, wealthy.
E.
द्रव्य, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-द्धिः)
Cleansing or purification of any soiled or defiled article.
E.
द्रव्य, and शुद्धि purity.

m. (-रः)
1 Consecration of articles for sacrifice.
2 Purification or cleansing of any articles soiled or defiled.
E.
द्रव्य, and संस्कार perfectioning.

m. (-यः)
Accumulation of property.
E.
द्रव्य, and सञ्चय collection.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Acquirement of wealth.
2 Effecting any thing by wealth.
E.
द्रव्य, and सिद्धि completion.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Holding any thing in the hand.
E.
द्रव्य, and हस्त hand.

n. (-नं)
Gain, acquisition, acquiring property.
E.
द्रव्य, and अर्ज्जन acquiring.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be seen, visible, apparent.
E.
दृश to see, तव्य affix, and ऋ changed to र.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Who or what sees, a spectator.
E.
दृश to see, तृच् aff.

r. 2nd cl. (द्राति)
1 To fly, to run away.
2 To be ashamed or spoiled.

ind.
Instantly, immediately, soon, shortly.
E.
द्रा to fly, कक् aff.

(इ) द्राक्षि r. 1st cl. (द्राङ्क्षति)
1 To croke, to caw, &c. as a bird.
2 To desire, to wish or long for.

f. (-क्षा)
A grape.
E.
द्राक्ष to desire, affix घञ्.

(ऋ,) द्राखृ^1 r. 1st cl. (द्राखति)
1 To be dry or arid.
2 To adorn.
3 To be able or competent.
4 To prohibit, to prevent.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.

(ऋ) दाधृ r. 1st cl. (द्राघते)
1 To be able or competent.
2 To stretch, to lengthen.
3 To tire, to be tired or fatigued.

m. (-मा)
Length.
E.
दीर्घ, and इमनिच् affix, the first syllable changed.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Long, lengthy.
E.
द्राघिमन्, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Longest, very long.
E.
दीर्घ long, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, and द्राध substituted for दीर्घ.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very or exceeding long.
E.
दीर्घ, and ईयसुन् affix, deriv. irr.

(ऋ) दाघृ r. 1st cl. (द्राडते)
To divide, to split, to pierce, to pull to pieces, &c.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Flown, run away, &c.
E.
द्रु to fly, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

m. (-पः)
1 Mud, mire.
2 Heaven, sky.
3 A fool, an idiot.
4 A cowri.

m. (-लः)
The Muni CĀṆAKYA.
E.
द्रमिल a proper name, and अण् patronymick aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A kind of stone, (a loadstone.)
2 A wit, a wag, a sharp or clever man.
3 A thief.
4 A libertine, a lecher.
5 A pursuer, a chaser, one who causes to fly.
6 A sort of Rasa or quality.
n. (-कं)
Bee's wax.
E.
द्रु to fly, affix ण्वुल्.

n. (-रं)
1 A kind of borax.
2 A flux.
E.
द्राव fusion, and कर what makes.

n. (-नं)
1 The clearing nut.
2 Causing to fly or retreat.
3

Fusing.
4

Distilling.
E.
द्रु to go or retreat, in the causal form, अच् aff.

f. (-का)
Saliva.
E.
द्रु to ooze out, ण्वुल् affix, and the fem. form.

m. (-कः)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.)
n. (-कं)
Black salt.
E.
कन् added to the preceding, growing in the country of Drāvira.

m. (-कः)
Zedoary.
E.
द्राविड the country, भूत being, affix ठक्: see the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Melted, liquefied.
2 Softened, mollified.
3 Driven, chased.
E.
द्रु to go, causal form, क्त aff.

(ऋ) द्राह r. 1st cl. (द्राहते)
1 To wake.
2 To deposit, to pledge.

m. (-हः)
A son.
f. (-ही)
A daughter.
E.
द्रुह to hurt, affix क.
